schedules.repeat: Repeat the full call after resetting and poisoning the cache and workspace.
schedules.tokenwise: One token per call, including the 4096-token case.
schedules.irregular_tail: Append the remaining suffix, clipping each declared chunk at the case length.

confirmation.prompt: A rectangle has a perimeter of 30 meters and a width of 5 meters. Explain how to find its length and area.

accuracy: Unchanged decoder-layer-v1 whole-layer and isolated-operation gates; exact Hugging Face agreement is not required.
invariance: All 16 stored stages, including Y, and both active KV prefixes must equal the candidate's own full-call bytes on the same hardware and build. Candidate bytes may differ from configuration 20.
selection: Fast: validated measured winner per exact workload and reuse mode. Deterministic: a compatible arithmetic family across schedules; no independent phase winners unless cross-phase invariance passes. Unmeasured cells fall back to the declared baseline.
timing: Four paired blocks, ten warmups and ten observations per arm, balanced order, same-run self-pair calibration, all valid observations retained. A gain requires all four ratios below one and a reduction exceeding max(5%, self-pair deviation).
scope: One Qwen2.5-0.5B decoder layer on Apple Metal. Historical full-model accuracy failures remain separate; no full-model or cross-device determinism claim.

22.qkv: Packed projection followed by bit-preserving unpack
22.reduction: Original lane-strided FP32 sums and warp.sum; no changed K partition

rounds.rationale: At (256,256), MLP is 85.225% of ID20 captured GPU active time; at (64,4096), MLP is 68.538% and GQA is 20.592%. Test projection reuse first.

numerical.admission: Every unchanged numerical gate must pass before timing. Classify every candidate's schedule invariance. A non-invariant but numerically valid candidate remains eligible only for Fast. Exclude a failed candidate from timing and retain its failure.

rounds.fast_selection: Per cell and reuse mode, retain the incumbent unless a numerically valid candidate passes the existing direct paired faster rule against it. Select the lowest qualifying median ratio, then the lower ID.
rounds.deterministic_selection: If ID22 is invariant and byte-compatible with ID20, select it only in cells where its direct comparison to ID20 passes the existing faster rule; otherwise retain ID20. ID21 can replace this family globally only if it is invariant, every screened cell in both modes is faster than ID20, and, wherever ID22 qualifies, ID21 ratio_max is below (1-noise_floor) times ID22 ratio_min. Otherwise retain ID21 as a documented tradeoff. Unmeasured cells use ID20, or ID21 if that global family qualifies.
rounds.confirmation: Freeze the proposed lookup before the sole independent confirmation. Include all seven original cells in both modes. The 4096-row prefill candidate is an explicitly unmeasured extension until confirmation qualifies it; retain the validated fallback on failure. Fresh numerical confirmation executes the actual Fast/Deterministic lookups in both modes (test IDs100-103), requires invariance for101/103, and requires full-stage/KV compatibility between101 and103.
